# Payment fixture

This isolated project is for Project View AC-06 verification. Payment architecture has API validation, payment orchestration, and an in-memory store. Read src/payment to determine facts. A request to reorganize architecture means update Architecture Knowledge and, only if necessary, its View Definition under .ai-studio using the client's GUIDE and schemas. Do not refactor source, install packages, use the network, or touch paths outside this project. Prefer the built-in definition; write complete valid JSON. This fixture contains no real customer data or secrets.

data.summary: 支付模块由 API 校验、支付编排和内存存储组成。请求经校验后创建 pending 状态的支付记录并写入内存 Map。 AC06-CODEX-R2

modules.name: 支付 API
modules.responsibility: 接收订单号与分金额；校验订单号非空且金额大于 0，然后调用支付服务。

modules.name: 支付服务
modules.responsibility: 按订单创建 pending 状态的支付记录，生成 payment-<orderId> 标识，交给存储并返回记录。

modules.name: 支付存储
modules.responsibility: 使用进程内 Map 按支付 ID 保存记录，并提供按 ID 查询。

# Payment fixture

data.summary: 支付模块由三层组成：api 负责入参校验并转发，service 负责创建支付单，store 以内存 Map 保存支付单。调用链为 postPayment → createPayment → savePayment，当前没有持久化和外部支付渠道对接。 AC06-CLAUDE-R2

modules.name: api
modules.responsibility: postPayment 校验 orderId 非空且 amountCents > 0，不合法时抛出 'Invalid payment'，合法时调用 createPayment

modules.name: service
modules.responsibility: createPayment 生成 id 为 payment-<orderId>、status 为 pending 的支付单并保存，返回该支付单

modules.name: store
modules.responsibility: 进程内 Map（以支付单 id 为键）的内存存储，提供 savePayment 与 findPayment；findPayment 当前无调用方
